prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right agency depends on what you need, your budget, industry, timeline, and what “best” means (big-brand creative, measurable digital performance, B2B lead gen, etc.).

If you want, I can produce a tailored shortlist. To help, tell me:
- What are your primary goals? (brand awareness, lead generation, e‑commerce sales, PR, etc.)
- Which services do you need? (strategy, creative/branding, web design, SEO, paid media, social, PR, content, marketing automation)
- What’s your budget or typical monthly/annual spend?
- Industry and typical customer (B2B/B2C)?
- Timeline (ongoing vs. short project)?
- Any other constraints (must be local, prefer small/boutique, diversity goals)?

How to choose an agency (quick checklist)
- Specialization: match services + industry experience.
- Case studies & measurable results: ask for KPIs and outcomes, not just creative work.
- Team & availability: who will actually do the work and how often will you meet?
- Culture & communication fit: processes, reporting cadence, responsiveness.
- Pricing & contract terms: retainer vs. project vs. performance fees, exit terms.
- Tools & tech: analytics, ad platforms, CMS, marketing automation.
- References and reviews: ask for client references and check Clutch/Google/LinkedIn.
- Trial project: start with a small paid pilot to test fit.

Where to search and verify agencies
- Clutch.co and UpCity for client reviews and rankings
- Google Maps + Yelp for local reviews
- LinkedIn for agency pages and staff bios
- Local industry groups/awards: AAF Kansas City, PRSA KC, Kansas City Business Journal agency lists

If you want, give me the details above and I’ll shortlist 4–6 Kansas City agencies that fit your needs and explain why each is a good match.
